name: Amamiya Arisa
source:
Against her parents' idea of having a clear goal in life, Arisa keeps holding on her dream of becoming actor and always tries her best alone. After passing the exam and being chosen as sub post in real stage performance, she now has to confront with the merciless rule impaired on non-main actors which requires them to pay a considerable amount of money for ticket quota and it's obviously impossible for a student like her to achieve this before the deadline. 

Not being able to rely on anyone and let go of this chance, she decides to put hands on compensated dating for the first time in order to earn enough money in within a short period of time. That's how she meets protagonist who would later become the most important person to her.

[spoiler]At first she is scared and acts cold toward him. However, after being touched by his kindness, she soon opens her heart and relies on him as the only person who truly understands and accepts her.

There are two endings in which one is she keeps chasing her dream while having him supporting her and looking forward to their future, another is she gives up her dream and decides to live with him for the rest of her life despite her parents' opposition.[/spoiler]
